architecture:
System: RemoteMaintenance-Bastion
Assessment focus: MA-4 (Nonlocal Maintenance)

Remote maintenance is initiated only through a private bastion host using phishing-resistant MFA. Each session requires an approved work order, is limited to the named target, is recorded, and is terminated automatically when the maintenance window closes. Vendor accounts have no standing production access.
